candidate_finding.summary: The candidate reads the valid O-owned signed decision with the runtime-only artifact loader during both retained-session authorization derivation and execution, so every contract-compliant physical call is rejected before dispatch.
candidate_finding.contract: O independently creates authorization-decisions/{CALL_ID}.json in the attempt-evidence root; C3-HARNESS consumes it read-only and creates the derived authorization under runtime hil/{lane-id}/authorizations/.
candidate_finding.smallest_sufficient_repair: Load and hash the decision as a closed external read-only artifact at the two decision-consumption sites while retaining runtime-only loading for candidate-authored proposal and authorization artifacts.
candidate_finding.repair_route: Return to the owning candidate implementation step for one narrow repair, focused regression tests, independent complete review, fresh C0/C1/C2, a fresh host-only rehearsal, and a fresh C3 attempt.

watcher_procedure_finding.summary: The W reasoning turn completed before target work while its helper kept the process identity live; consequently W did not classify the later candidate defect, emit ABORT_REQUIRED, or write a terminal report.
watcher_procedure_finding.repair_route: Keep the correction prompt-only and prove in a fresh host-only rehearsal that W remains semantically active through a delayed injected candidate violation, emits its own abort record, and writes a terminal report without a second watcher framework.

root_supervisor_procedure_finding.summary: Failure cleanup treated the already-exited signer as an inexact live termination target and raised before requesting the governing watcher stop.
root_supervisor_procedure_finding.repair_route: Correct only the external supervisor cleanup procedure so an already-exited registered process is an idempotent cleanup success, then cover that ordering in the host-only rehearsal.

triage.candidate_fix_reason: Without it no correctly separated signed decision can reach candidate authorization derivation, so all required physical calls are impossible.
triage.watcher_fix_reason: A mechanically live but semantically finished watcher cannot independently detect or report an acceptance defect.
triage.root_supervisor_fix_reason: Cleanup must finish when an already-registered child exits naturally before the supervisor reaches it.
